walkthroughs.body_html:
Communicating Visual Arts — a core area of Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Communicating Visual Arts brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Communicating Visual Arts.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between relief and intaglio printing?
options: Relief is for paper, intaglio is for fabric.
Relief prints from raised surfaces; intaglio prints from incised lines below the surface.
They are different names for the same process.
Using only blue and green.
Removing material from a solid block to reveal the form (e.g., carving stone).
Casting in plaster.
Using only blue and green.
Subtracting one sculpture from another.

mcqs.q: What is the central innovation of Cubism?
options: Showing an object from multiple viewpoints simultaneously on a flat surface.
Relief is for paper, intaglio is for fabric.
Painting everything as cubes.
Using only blue and green.
